# CBDB-Desktop: Status (Look At Status) label revisions, 2026-10-28

Tenth form in the review of HTML labels against the MS Access FormLabels table (form code LAS, 31 rows in the updated 643-row table). Changes are in the Status form's index.html only; no back-end or stylesheet change was needed. The page script was syntax-checked, and the page was loaded in a scripted browser (jsdom): all 25 labels written by setLanguage were compared with their translations in all three languages, and STA-4 was checked, with no script errors. **Not yet tested in the running app.** A copy of the file before these changes was kept as index.before-labels.html. STA-1 to STA-3 are in the report of 2026-10-16. Revised later the same day with the user's answers: the People tab wording confirmed, and the Help button removed (STA-5).

## How to revert a label

All labels are in the translations object near the top of the script, under english, traditional and simplified. Change the value of the key in the **Key** column, in the language concerned. Each line has a comment naming its FormLabels row (or "No row") and, where changed, the earlier wording. Where the English changed, the same text is also written in the HTML element; setLanguage('english') overwrites it on load.

## Notes

**Status is 社會區分 throughout.** The form used 身份 for Status in its title, heading, Select Status button and tab. LAS 4 and 9 have 社會區分, as BIO 52 and LAG 10 do (and as decided for Group Data, LBL-39, which also cleared the 身份 item in CBDB-D-004). The Status results column was already headed 社會區分.

**LBL-105.** "CBDB: Look At Status" / "CBDB: 查看社會區分". The title was fixed text ("CBDB — Look At Status / 查看身份"); the span got id="pageTitle", and setLanguage also sets document.title.

**LBL-106.** This form's link already read "← Navigation" but in English only. It got id="lnkNavigation" and the navigation key.

**LBL-107, LBL-108.** The two section headings were fixed bilingual text ("Status / 身份", "Place / 地點"); they now have ids (statusH3, placeH3) and keys. The Place heading uses 地名, the term the review uses for Place (Select Place 選擇地名, SF_ADDR 16). The "…" at the end of Select Status, Select Place and Select Dynasty appeared only until the page loaded, since setLanguage wrote the labels without it; the markup now matches. Include Subordinate Units and Use XY References are LAS 20 and 16; the enable-with-place behaviour was already in place (STA-2). **Check the width** of their row: both labels share one line.

**LBL-109.** The radio buttons keep their English and take LAS 26–28 in Chinese (無時限, 利用指數年, 利用朝代), replacing 無日期 and 使用指數年份 / 使用朝代; the simplified 使用指數年份 had traditional 指數. From / To are 始年 / 終年 (LAS 1, 2), replacing 起 / 終; no colons, as before. "Select Dynasty…" becomes **Select Dynasties** (選擇朝代), as on the other forms. The All Dynasties button was fixed English with no id; it now has id="btnAllDynasties" and the allDynasties key (LAS 24, 所有朝代). The key of that name had held the dynasty summary's "All" (全部); that value moved to a new key, dynastyAll.

**LBL-110.** As on the other forms: 查詢, 匯出 (traditional), 儲存人物代碼 / 存储人物代码, 保存于GIS, 保存于Neo4j (replacing 保存到…).

**LBL-111. Tabs.** Status is 社會區分 (LAS 9). For People, LAS 10 has 社會關係的人 ("people in associations"), which is the Associations form's tab (LAA 11) and wrong here. The Texts form's row for the same tab (LAT 10, 有文本角色的人, "people with a text role") gives the pattern, so People is **有社會區分的人** / 有社会区分的人 ("people with a status"), confirmed by the user on 2026-10-28.

**Removed.** The exportOptions key (Export Options:) had no element on the page; it was removed, as the Office form's Export Options heading was (user, 2026-10-28).

## STA-4: Status selection summary followed the language only in English

updateStatusDisplay() wrote "No status selected" and "Multi-select (N items)" in English whatever the language, and setLanguage did not refresh it. Both now come from new keys, noStatusSelected (未選擇社會區分) and multiSelect (多選（N項）, with {n} replaced by the count), and setLanguage calls updateStatusDisplay(). A single selected status still shows its description as the picker returns it, and the status-type line is unchanged (it already shows English and Chinese).

**jsdom check.** In each language: on load the summary shows the translated "No status selected"; after selecting three status codes it shows "Multi-select (3 items)" / 多選（3項） / 多选（3项）.

## STA-5: Help button removed

The Help button opened an English-only alert() with one generic sentence. The Access version had a PDF help file for each form; the new version has none yet, so the button was removed (user, 2026-10-28). Removed: the btnHelp button, its setLanguage line, the help key in all three languages, and showHelp(). A comment where showHelp() was notes the removal and that LAS 15 (Help 幫助 / 帮助) is the label to use if Help returns. No other reviewed form has a Help button.
